name: Jerry Markham Farm Stand
tagline: Shop for Food from Local Farmers and Vendors!
description: In Atkins, AR, Jerry Markham Farm Stand grows Blackberries and Grapes on a family-run farm stand. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer and autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
